description: This file defines the EnterpriseCallbackControls class which manages checking whether certain callbacks are disabled dynamically, either via headers or request parameters, within an enterprise context. It includes methods to determine if specific callback functions should be disabled based on request headers or internal state.

classes.name: EnterpriseCallbackControls
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to check if callbacks are disabled dynamically based on headers or request parameters.

methods.name: bool is_callback_disabled_dynamically( callback: litellm.CALLBACK_TYPES, litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams )
methods.description: Determines whether a specific callback should be disabled based on request headers or dynamic parameters.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] get_disabled_callbacks(litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of disabled callbacks specified either in request headers or in the standard callback dynamic parameters.

methods.name: _should_allow_dynamic_callback_disabling()
methods.description: Checks whether dynamic callback disabling is allowed, considering admin settings and user permissions.

ctags.name: is_callback_disabled_dynamically
ctags.signature: ( callback: litellm.CALLBACK_TYPES, litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams )
